qualification.selector_correction: The first command used an incorrect system.NativeTypedGraphicsHostAxiSpec selector and ran 39 checks. A separate successful run used graphics.NativeTypedGraphicsHostAxiSpec on identical frozen sources and ran five checks. The 44 total is explicitly the sum of both logs.

scope: 12 transfer checks include 7520 row refills, six cancellation arrivals, all formats and 1x/2x/4x tile shapes

Image/replay/combined-owner checks cover real shared CUs, local/global payloads, indexed instances, 4x MSAA, exact guarded MRT/depth source and resolve bytes, cached visibility, faults and cancellation
Five existing GTJ1 native AXI checks cover translated resources, instruction/write permissions, physical stores, live shader/publication reset and healthy reuse
limitations: These AXI checks cover the existing ordinary typed native host, not the new GNJ1 native binned owner/fabric being developed in a separate branch
Runtime uses reduced lane/warp capacities and small images; no full Mobile rate/frame/budget closure
Replay-engine repeat synthesis is running separately; no timing improvement or power result is claimed by functional verification
PPA policy remains synthesis only; H0-H8 and resource/production integration gates remain open
